LanguageData.MooGirl_KnightHelmet.description: A knight helmet adapted to a Mugirl head shape and horn position, providing stable full-head protection.
LanguageData.MooGirl_KnightHelmet.label: Mugirl Knight Helmet
LanguageData.MooGirl_PowerArmor.description: Heavy power armor adjusted for the Mugirl body shape. It strengthens carrying capacity and melee motion while retaining some mobility under full-body protection.
LanguageData.MooGirl_PowerArmor.label: Mugirl Power Armor
LanguageData.MooGirl_PowerArmorHelmet.description: A fully enclosed helmet paired with Mugirl power armor, balancing environmental resistance with close- and mid-range shooting support.
LanguageData.MooGirl_PowerArmorHelmet.label: Mugirl Power Armor Helmet
LanguageData.MooGirl_ReverseBunnySticker.description: Three-piece sticker ornaments for the reverse bunny set. They can be worn with underwear as hidden ornaments to complete the overall style.
LanguageData.MooGirl_ReverseBunnySticker.label: Mugirl Reverse Bunny Stickers
LanguageData.MooGirl_ReverseBunnySuit.description: A reverse bunny suit made exclusively for Mugirls, using bolder openings and a close-fitting cut to emphasize charm while retaining light basic protection.
LanguageData.MooGirl_ReverseBunnySuit.label: Mugirl Reverse Bunny Suit
LanguageData.MooGirl_Spacesuit.description: A close-fitting Mugirl-exclusive spacesuit that provides all-weather environmental protection while avoiding interference with outer equipment as much as possible.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Spacesuit.label: Mugirl Spacesuit
LanguageData.MooGirl_SpacesuitHeadgear.description: Lightweight headgear prepared for the Mugirl spacesuit, built within the existing Mugirl headwear system to complete environmental sealing.
LanguageData.MooGirl_SpacesuitHeadgear.label: Mugirl Spacesuit Headgear
LanguageData.MooGirl_WarriorCombatArmor.description: Full protective combat armor optimized for Mugirls, covering the limbs and torso while emphasizing load-bearing and sustained ranged combat capability.
LanguageData.MooGirl_WarriorCombatArmor.label: Mugirl Warrior Combat Armor
LanguageData.MooGirl_WarriorCombatHelmet.description: A heavy helmet paired with the warrior full protective suit, emphasizing frontal protection and shooting stability.
LanguageData.MooGirl_WarriorCombatHelmet.label: Mugirl Warrior Helmet
LanguageData.MooGirl_WhitePanties.description: Soft white silk underwear made exclusively for Mugirls. Its close-fitting cut forms the base of the white silk outfit, providing basic warmth and a charm bonus.
LanguageData.MooGirl_WhitePanties.label: Mugirl White Silk Underwear
